findings.title: Discard superseded history loads before publishing sync statuses
findings.body: The replay-completion handler starts another loadHistory() without superseding any request already running. mergedSessions() snapshots local sync states before awaiting fetchSessions(), so a history load started while a session is queued/syncing can finish after the new completion-triggered load. It then passes this same-account guard and overwrites the fresh .synced statuses with its older snapshots, restoring “Pending sync” indefinitely after successful replay. Add a load generation or equivalent latest-request check before publishing the history and status dictionaries.
